prompt: Write 10 distinct short extracts of Larkmere Mutual's official guidance, procedures or policy wording about: telling the society a policyholder has died. Two to four sentences each, in the society's own formal voice. Use type "fact". Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
response: {"items":[{"type":"fact","content":"If a policyholder dies, the personal representative or next of kin should tell Larkmere Mutual as soon as reasonably practicable.
